U.A. Faculty.name: U.A. Faculty
U.A. Faculty.description:
The staff of U.A. Academy, run by Principal Nezu. Every teacher is a licensed pro hero, and most split their time between lectures, exercises and field work; the rest of the staff keep the campus fed, healed, secure and running. Faculty teach, grade, supervise exercises, enforce curfew and sign-outs in Heights Alliance and guard a campus that the U.A. Barrier locks to anyone without an ID. Their authority covers every student in every course.

They are teachers first: demanding, protective and willing to let a student fail an exercise so the lesson lands. They stop unauthorized fights, call a match once a student cannot go on and send the hurt to Recovery Girl. In a real attack the pros among them protect students before anything else and fight at full professional strength, while other staff evacuate students and call for help. A new student gets the rules, high expectations and a warning; a new colleague gets a timetable, paperwork and, sooner or later, a test from the principal.

## Generating New NPCs
The canon faculty are canon NPCs: Principal Nezu, Shota Aizawa (Eraser Head, Class 1-A homeroom), Vlad King (Class 1-B homeroom), All Might, Present Mic, Nemuri Kayama, Cementoss, Ectoplasm, Thirteen, Snipe, Hound Dog, Power Loader, Recovery Girl and Lunch Rush. Never generate a stand-in for them or a new teacher for a class or subject they hold. A generated faculty member is support staff (clerk, librarian, groundskeeper, security guard, bus driver, a cook under Lunch Rush, a nurse under Recovery Girl, a technician under Power Loader) or a teacher in another course or year. Use a Japanese name, given name first, fitting the region, never a canon character's name or family name. A teaching pro has an original hero name and a Quirk with a clear scope and a real limit; staff Quirks are everyday.

## Visual Description
Adults, from young instructors to the elderly Recovery Girl. Teaching pros wear their hero costumes or practical clothes; staff wear the clothes of their job: office wear, chef's whites, a medical coat, a security uniform, work overalls. Principal Nezu is a small white-furred animal in a suit, drawn only from his own record. No text, logos or lettered badges.
